about: Expected answers to group A, computed from the local database by compute_expected_a.py. Unconfirmed until Nic sets confirmed: true (and confirmed_by) on each entry.

questions.rule: Coral & benthic cover page (backend/coral.py): stony coral = every taxon except CTB, sand, macroalgae, Millepora, soft coral, non-coralline crustose algae, unknown or other, Cyanophyceae; summed per quadrat, quadrats averaged within each transect section, sections averaged.
questions.sql:
WITH src AS (
      SELECT try_cast(left(date,4) AS INTEGER) AS year, try_cast(substr(date,6,2) AS INTEGER) AS month, site,
        CASE WHEN habitat='Fringing' THEN 'Fringing' ELSE 'Forereef '||depth||' m' END AS habitat,
        section_of_transect AS section, quad40 AS quad,
        taxonomy_substrate_or_functional_group AS taxon, percent_cover AS v
      FROM data_5529b3cb6a95e0 WHERE habitat IN ('Fringing','Forereef')),
    quads AS (SELECT year,site,habitat,section,quad,min(month) AS m0,max(month) AS m1,
      sum(v) FILTER (WHERE taxon NOT IN ('CTB','Sand','Macroalgae','Millepora','Soft Coral','Non-coralline Crustose Algae','Unknown or Other','Cyanophyceae')) AS v,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE taxon NOT IN ('CTB','Sand','Macroalgae','Millepora','Soft Coral','Non-coralline Crustose Algae','Unknown or Other','Cyanophyceae')) AS group_rows,
      count(v) FILTER (WHERE taxon NOT IN ('CTB','Sand','Macroalgae','Millepora','Soft Coral','Non-coralline Crustose Algae','Unknown or Other','Cyanophyceae')) AS finite_rows
      FROM src GROUP BY ALL),
    sections AS (SELECT year,site,habitat,section,avg(v) AS v,min(m0) AS m0,max(m1) AS m1
      FROM quads WHERE group_rows>0 AND finite_rows=group_rows GROUP BY ALL)
    SELECT site,habitat,year,avg(v) AS value,min(m0) AS month_first,max(m1) AS month_last
    FROM sections GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY habitat,site,year
-- then: site = LTER_1, habitat = Forereef 10 m, highest value

cross_check.sql:
WITH q AS (SELECT left(date,4) AS year, location, sum(percent_cover) AS v
  FROM data_5529b3cb6a95e0
  WHERE site='LTER_1' AND habitat='Forereef' AND depth='10'
    AND taxonomy_substrate_or_functional_group NOT IN ('CTB', 'Sand', 'Macroalgae', 'Millepora', 'Soft Coral', 'Non-coralline Crustose Algae', 'Unknown or Other', 'Cyanophyceae')
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT year, avg(v) AS mean_cover_pct, count(*) AS quadrats FROM q GROUP BY year ORDER BY mean_cover_pct DESC LIMIT 3

questions.note: 2018 is close behind (80.5%); a plain mean over quadrats also gives 2019 (80.6% vs 80.3%). Cover then falls to 14.9% in 2020 and 0.1% in 2024.

checks.text: Names 2019 as the highest year (in a sentence saying so, or as the headline).

questions.rule: Coral cover page (backend/coral.py series): valid quadrats averaged within each patch, patches weighted equally within a site; then the six site means averaged (every site has 5 patches in 2025).
questions.sql:
WITH source AS (
      SELECT try_cast(year AS INTEGER) AS year,site,patch,quad,"coral" AS v
      FROM data_de5685f79bcdc2 WHERE habitat='Backreef' AND depth=2
        AND site IN ('LTER_1','LTER_2','LTER_3','LTER_4','LTER_5','LTER_6')
        AND try_cast(year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2025 AND 2025),
    patches AS (SELECT year,site,patch,
      avg(v) FILTER (WHERE isfinite(v) AND v BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AS patch_mean,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE isfinite(v) AND v BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AS n,
      count(*) AS source_rows FROM source GROUP BY year,site,patch),
    summaries AS (SELECT year,site,avg(patch_mean) AS value,min(patch_mean) AS lo,
      max(patch_mean) AS hi,sum(n)::INTEGER AS n,sum(source_rows)::INTEGER AS source_rows,
      count(patch_mean)::INTEGER AS n_patches FROM patches GROUP BY year,site),
    bins AS (SELECT unnest(range(2025,2026)) AS year),
    sites AS (SELECT unnest(['LTER_1', 'LTER_2', 'LTER_3', 'LTER_4', 'LTER_5', 'LTER_6']) AS site)
    SELECT site,year,cast(year AS VARCHAR) AS date,value,lo,hi,
      coalesce(n,0) AS n,coalesce(source_rows,0) AS source_rows,
      coalesce(n_patches,0) AS n_patches,n::DOUBLE/nullif(source_rows,0) AS coverage
    FROM (sites CROSS JOIN bins) LEFT JOIN summaries USING(site,year) ORDER BY site,year
questions.note: Site means run from 1.2% (LTER 2) to 35.4% (LTER 6). The question asks for one average, so the spread across sites is a caveat worth stating.

questions.sql:
SELECT year, site, sum(cots) AS cots, count(cots) AS transects
FROM data_8dfa1f5467b251 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY cots DESC LIMIT 5

cross_check.sql: SELECT year, sum(cots) ... GROUP BY year

questions.note: 2008 is the highest year in total (127) and LTER 4 the highest site that year (41, all on the forereef); LTER 6 is close (39). Counts are per four transects per habitat; the source does not state the transect area here.

checks.text: Names 2008 (in a sentence saying it is highest, or as the headline).

questions.rule: Fish page (backend/fish.py): biomass (g) / swath area, swaths added per transect, transects averaged; herbivores = Coarse_Trophic "Primary Consumer" (herbivores and detritivores).
questions.sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT transect,
    coalesce(sum(biomass / CASE try_cast(swath AS INTEGER) WHEN 1 THEN 50.0 WHEN 5 THEN 250.0 END)
      FILTER (WHERE coarse_trophic = 'Primary Consumer' AND taxonomy IS NOT NULL AND biomass IS NOT NULL), 0) AS g_m2,
    list(DISTINCT swath ORDER BY swath) AS swaths
  FROM data_89cd4b309bc073
  WHERE year = '2023' AND site = 'LTER_4' AND habitat = 'Forereef'
  GROUP BY transect)
SELECT avg(g_m2) AS mean_g_m2, count(*) AS transects, list(round(g_m2, 2) ORDER BY transect) AS per_transect FROM t
questions.note: Transects 11.7–21.1 g/m². Dividing everything by 250 m², or using the fine trophic groups, gives other numbers; the check accepts only the page rule.

questions.sql:
SELECT avg(phosphate) AS mean_umol_l, count(phosphate) AS samples, count(*) AS rows_total
FROM data_def72abee9557e
questions.note: 436 rows, one with phosphate NA. The rows mix Niskin bottles and Falcon tubes, and the LTER bi-annual and "Additional nutrients" cruises; a good answer says so.

checks.text: Gives about 0.143 µmol/L (0.139–0.147 accepted, so 0.14 passes).

questions.rule: Sum of counts for genus Diadema (D. savignyi, D. setosum) in the 20 one-square-metre quadrats.
questions.sql:
SELECT taxonomy, sum(count) AS urchins, count(*) AS quadrats
FROM data_1b0e3474b88488
WHERE site = 'LTER_1' AND habitat = 'Backreef' AND year = '2010' AND taxonomy ILIKE '%diadema%'
GROUP BY taxonomy ORDER BY taxonomy
questions.note: Echinothrix diadema (9 counted) is a different genus; including it gives 12. The 2010 survey date is stored as 2010-01-01 for every row.

checks.text: Does not lead with 12 (Echinothrix diadema counted as Diadema); a later aside about 12 is fine.

questions.rule: Highest monthly mean nighttime SST from MODIS Aqua (the only SST column); -999 is missing.
questions.sql:
SELECT year, month, mean_nsst_aqua, pct_valid_nsst_aqua FROM data_303d9644b435ed
WHERE mean_nsst_aqua > -900 ORDER BY mean_nsst_aqua DESC LIMIT 3
questions.note: The SST series runs 2002-07-01 to 2020-04-01 (213 months), so later heat is not in it. April 2020 is 0.07 °C lower. A good answer says it is nighttime SST and where the series ends.

questions.rule: Sum of Pocilloporidae counts by shore and season (missing codes -1, -2 excluded).
questions.sql:
SELECT shore, season, sum(count) AS recruits, count(DISTINCT nominal_year || location || tile_id) AS tiles
FROM data_fa2f2b7f84e384 WHERE family = 'Pocilloporidae' AND count >= 0
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY recruits DESC
questions.note: Most tiles are on the north shore, so totals mostly reflect effort; recruits per tile is the fairer comparison and gives the same top cell. A good answer says so.

checks.text: Names the north shore, January–September deployments.
